trace.notes: No current-livery 156 diagram exists (stage A): positions from the pre-2016 Northern one.
trace.open: cab end checked on phex (156487 at Hexham, near side, nose left; hex1 grid): the order and spacing match the diagram (cab window, door, one small window, then the big windows with a short gap: the 0.7 m between the small window and window 1 is plain). A 1D projective fit on windows 1-3 (residuals up to 13 cm at this resolution) extrapolates the small window to 4.0-4.6 and the door to 2.3-3.3, 0.3-0.65 m behind the diagram; the earlier palt reading put the door 2 m AHEAD: both are extrapolations past the fitted run and disagree in sign, and on palt the 'small window' picked was not that window. Diagram positions kept; the palt camera match is withdrawn (its picks were misidentified)
trace.liveries.NT.purple: Northern purple: the mean of the three measured raw samples of the same paint (150 purple-118 #4B578D, 155 purple-346 #36374D balanced #585C8E, 156 nt-purple-dar #31306F): #474C83; the 156's own darkest sample alone rendered too blue and saturated
trace.liveries.SR.saltire: the dotted saltire as the 158 SR's (classes/158/spec.json liveries.SR: white saltire dots at the cab end, light blue graded dots low on the bodyside, from the ScotRail diagram) placed for this class from pgc (156505 at Glasgow Central): the white dots fill the cab end from the corner to 1.65 m (the 158's 0-1.63 m scaled to it), heights scaled between skirt and cantrail; the blue graded dots start 2.65 m (the 158's 2.76 m, just behind its first door, moved to this class's), heights scaled to end at the window bottom, as on the photo. Dot pitch as the 158's (0.10 / 0.29 m)
trace.liveries.SR.dots: third pass, outlines traced on pgc (pgcfull grid; along: door 1's front edge u 1330 = 1.65 m and the cab corner u 1530 = 0, 121 px/m; up: cantrail v 930 = 3.3 m, solebar v ~1340 = 1.0 m, 178 px/m). White saltire arm: row by row from v 940 to 1290 its rear and front ends (u 1425-1470 at the top ... 1407-1520 at mid height, reaching the corner ... 1345-1420 at the foot): a diagonal band, narrow at the top beside the cab window, reaching the corner at about 1.9 m and leaning back towards the door at the bottom. Light blue: from the window bottom (1.90) down to near the solebar (1.05), 7 rows (row pitch 0.13), from the door back about 3 m, its rear boundary a slanted diagonal (5.4 m at the top, 6.0 m at the foot). Other classes: the 156's outlines scaled to their own cab end (white: to their first door; blue: from behind the door) and heights ; the white arm widened by one column (0.21 m, scaled) at mid height (rows 4-8) after a comparison with pgc
trace.model.nose.profile.lower: below the body: the diagrams (150 dia2, 153, 155, 156) draw the cab face flat and vertical down to its lowest painted item, with the headstock, coupler and snowplough under it; there is no sloping chin (the old flatProfile slanted back from 1.05 to 0.55 m at 0.25 m).
